description: Create a private, shareable static report link for 1-2 public URLs. The report is rendered from the same scan output as scan_url — free callers get the aggregate report, Pro/Team callers get the detailed one — and the link works in any browser without an API key. Compare mode puts two URLs side by side; keyed reports add a per-rule delta. Use when: You want a link to paste into Slack, docs, email, or a pull request so a person (or link-preview bot) can read the scan without the API key. Avoid when: You need the raw scan result right now. Use scan_url and keep the JSON in context. Do not claim: A report is a snapshot of one scan — not a citation and not a live measurement. Verify: Open the returned https://aeogeo.site/r/<id> URL, or append ?format=md or ?format=json for other export formats. expires_at says when the link stops working.

expires_in_days.description: How long the link works, in days. Default: 30 for a Pro/Team report (it shows paid detail to anyone with the link), 90 for a free one. The owner can revoke a Pro/Team link earlier at https://mcp.aeogeo.site/account.

mode.description: single (default for one URL) or compare (two URLs, side by side).

urls.description: One URL for a single report, or two URLs for compare mode.

items.description: Absolute public http(s) URL to report on.

name: export_report
title: Create a report link
